d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 7 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.
Calo is seeking a commercially mature, systems-driven Head of Growth to architect and scale a unified Growth Operating System across all markets.
This role is responsible for end-to-end growth performance across all Mountain Peaks (MPs), owning performance marketing, lifecycle/CRM, SEO, CRO, and building a dedicated growth analytics function.

The Head of Growth will transition Calo away from a media-buying-led performance organization to an incrementality-driven, commercially disciplined growth engine grounded in contribution margin, payback modeling, and long-term value creation.
This is a strategic builder role, not a channel operator position.

Location: Open globally. Candidates must have at least 5 hours overlap with KSA working hours. Hybrid in countries where Calo has offices (KSA, UAE, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman); otherwise fully remote.
q: Multi-region centralized growth structure experience preferred
Commercial fluency in contribution margin, payback modeling, and budget allocation
Experience preparing or implementing MMM in mature markets
AI fluency in creative acceleration and experimentation tooling
Screening meeting with our TA team
Technical interview with the hiring manager
We’re not looking for cookie-cutter applications. Surprise us.

Show us your creativity, your drive, and who you are beyond a CV. Send a Loom, a Notion page, a deck, a video, a voice note, whatever feels most “you.” Tell us why you belong here at Calo and why this role excites you.
r: Redefine and standardize CAC, LTV, payback, and contribution margin frameworks across all regions
Implement stage-based growth investment models (startup, developing, mature regions)
Shift reporting from CPA-based to contribution-margin-based decision making
Partner with Finance to ensure growth investments meet capital allocation standards
Develop clear performance and growth budget reallocation logic across markets
Own and lead central performance marketing resources across MPs
Standardize paid media frameworks and testing structures
Design and implement performance ↔ creative feedback loops
Increase creative testing velocity through AI-enabled workflows
Diversify channel mix strategically and reduce dependency on legacy paid practices
Establish incrementality testing discipline (geo-testing, holdouts, structured experiments)
Evolve CRM into a full lifecycle marketing engine
Increase revenue expansion via segmentation and behavioral triggers
Align lifecycle strategy with subscription economics
Own landing page experimentation and funnel optimization
Hire and lead a growth analytics team
Partner with data and product teams to improve attribution and funnel modeling
Prepare mature markets for MMM readiness
Replace vanity metrics in reporting and replace with economic leading metrics
Operate in a matrix structure with country GMs and Demand Leads
Influence and closely align with product growth squads without directly owning them
Align brand and performance through shared KPIs
Challenge marketing investment assumptions where necessary

d: Coordinate inbound and outbound logistics for materials, equipment, tools, and project supplies.
Plan and coordinate transportation, including trucks, trailers, cranes, and other logistics resources.
Coordinate with suppliers, transporters, warehouses, site teams, and project management.
Track shipments and ensure materials are delivered to site according to project schedules.
Prepare and maintain delivery notes, GRNs, shipping documents, transport permits, and logistics records.
Monitor vehicle movements, driver schedules, loading/unloading activities, and delivery status.
Coordinate with procurement and warehouse teams regarding material availability and dispatch requirements.
Ensure proper handling, loading, securing, and transportation of materials and equipment.
Arrange transportation for mobilization/demobilization of personnel and equipment when required.
Monitor logistics costs and support cost-effective transportation planning.
Maintain updated logistics trackers and prepare daily/weekly status reports.
Resolve delivery delays, transportation issues, and site access constraints.
Ensure compliance with HSE requirements, site procedures, Saudi regulations, and client requirements.
Coordinate with customs/clearing agents for imported materials and equipment when applicable.
Support project teams during major mobilization, demobilization, and material movement activities.
RAYKEM Chemical Company is a growing specialty chemicals distribution business with operations in Saudi Arabia and the UAE.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Accountant to independently manage day-to-day accounting and financial reporting for our KSA and UAE entities. Based in Riyadh, you will report directly to senior management and work closely with our commercial and operations teams.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
At least 3 years of relevant accounting experience; 3–5 years preferred.
Practical experience independently handling accounts through month-end closing.
Hands-on experience preparing and filing KSA VAT returns through ZATCA.
Working knowledge of KSA Zakat and income tax requirements.
Experience in trading or distribution, including inventory accounting and multi-currency transactions, is preferred.
Proficiency in Zoho Books or similar accounting software, with strong Microsoft Excel skills.
UAE accounting and tax experience will be an advantage.
Strong written and spoken English is essential; Arabic is an advantage.
High attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to meet reporting deadlines.
r: Maintain complete and accurate books of accounts for the KSA and UAE entities.
Manage accounts receivable and payable, customer and supplier reconciliations, and receivables ageing.
Complete monthly closing and prepare the balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and cash flow reports.
Prepare and file KSA VAT returns through ZATCA and maintain supporting reconciliations.
Coordinate applicable Zakat and income tax compliance with external advisers.
Support UAE VAT and corporate tax compliance in coordination with external advisers.
Record intercompany transactions, reconcile balances, and prepare combined management reports.
Handle payroll accounting, bank reconciliations, and foreign currency transactions.
Reconcile inventory and landed costs in coordination with the operations team.
Prepare audit schedules and liaise with external auditors.
Maintain accounting records and reporting in Zoho Books.
x: Competitive compensation with a performance-linked bonus.
Exposure to regional operations and multi-currency trading.
Opportunities for professional growth as RAYKEM expands.
Email subject: Senior Accountant – Riyadh – [Your Name]
Please include your current location, notice period, expected monthly salary in SAR, and a brief summary of your KSA VAT filing and Zoho Books experience.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

q: 6+ years of experience in EPC Oil & Gas projects
Strong knowledge of procurement, expediting, vendor management, and logistics coordination
Experience with manufacturing processes, inspection requirements, and international shipments
Proficiency in SAP/ERP systems and advanced Excel reporting
